== Summary ==
Cover banner of [[Ultimate Legacy (Virtual Block 7)|Ultimate Legacy]], release 7.4 of [[Virtual Block 7]], from page 1 of its release PDF. The cover reads "Official text as of December 16, 2011". The file was created on 19 December 2011.

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf VirtualBlock7_4.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org. Page 1 rendered at 300 dpi, the resolution of the embedded cover images, and cropped to the banner (1954&times;1204 pixels). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174533/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf Internet Archive].
